limits.deadlineScope: Child execution is polled; group deadline is also checked after validation. Synchronous filesystem/system calls can delay a check, so this is not a hard end-to-end I/O timeout.

ownedProcesses.scope: Only identities observed as this spawned Node child or its descendants. PPID, PGID and any user-data-dir are retained as provenance; every signal rechecks start time, UID and exact argv. No process-group/name-wide signals.

scope: Each edition/package gets its own canonical process and immutable candidate. Each CLI builds twice, verifies original committed inputs and admits real source/runtime ZIP members. No combined release envelope, publication, device evidence or human signoff is claimed.
